purpose: Keep FIELD INDEX usable under growth: exact Git repository chronology for literal change, CURRENT for attention, showcase-manifest for addressed route projection, and one shared focus identity across AXIAL / route projections / map without allowing any projection to impersonate authority.
laws: ATTENTION ≠ RECENCY. /control/CURRENT.json owns NOW; Git commits own literal repository mutation chronology; route.index.updated_at is curated route-touch metadata only.
MAP ≠ BACKLOG. A route may exist without being active, owed, important or scheduled.
DONOR ≠ HEAD. Recovered and transfer-capable artifacts remain discoverable without competing for current-head status.
DISCUSSION ≠ INDEX TOUCH. A chat/thread mention does not change FIELD INDEX activity by itself.

MUTATION → INDEX TOUCH. A committed change to a tracked public surface updates that route's index.updated_at in the same bounded repo change, but the manifest timestamp is a route projection and never substitutes for the exact Git commit log.
ACTIVITY MODE ≠ OPERATION. Operation names what the artifact does; work_modes name what kind of work produced the current delta.
SPECULATION IS LEGIBLE, NOT PROMOTED. SPECULATE/SPECIFY may be indexed without implying implementation or evidence.
RECEIPT WHEN CLAIM CHANGES. If implementation/test/release status changes, update or create the relevant receipt and RETURN entry.
ADDRESS EVERY SURFACE; PROMOTE ALMOST NONE. Every directory index surface gets a manifest address or explicit alias disposition; sitemap inclusion never implies NOW, HEAD, priority or canon.
RETURN ≠ NEXT. RETURN closes and exposes evidence; every subsequent move is a fresh replan, not inherited route authority.

CONVERGENCE READ ≠ AUTHORITY. FIELD may compose QUEUE + federation-atlas as a read-only convergence projection; /nexus/ is a compatibility alias only. CURRENT owns attention/NOW, RETURN owns durable evidence, and board/map utilities cannot mint NEXT.
RECONSTRUCTION > NARRATION. Promote cross-lineage mechanisms only after a fresh process can reproduce the claimed behavior from durable state or an equivalent bounded test.
EXPERIMENT ≠ STATE. Experimental form is route.kind/operation; lifecycle state must say what can lawfully happen next.
EVOLUTION REQUIRES A HOST. A live experiment exists to change, transfer into, or falsify something outside itself; no ownerless experiment may accumulate roadmap authority.
CHRONOLOGY MAY REPEAT IDENTITY. Exact Git commits may touch the same route repeatedly; the manifest route projection compresses those commits into current addressed surface metadata.
DENSITY IS A PROJECTION. MARK / COMPACT / FULL may change information density but never identity, state, authority, order or target.
PROSE PAYS RENT. Fixed prose may not occupy persistent root space when the same function can survive as a mark with explicit reveal.
SELECTION ≠ NAVIGATION. Selecting a route in AXIAL, LATEST, HEADS, PORTS or MAP changes one local focus object; OPEN is the explicit navigation action.
ONE FOCUS / MANY PROJECTIONS. AXIAL strips, chronological rows and map positions must resolve to the same manifest route identity.
NO INTERSECTION ≠ NEAREST GUESS. An AXIAL tuple with no exact manifest match reports no match rather than inventing a route.
SUPPORT ≠ IMPORTANCE. AXIAL support counts are exact compatibility counts under the currently aligned dimensions, not priority, probability or recommendation.
VISIBLE POSSIBILITY SET. When constraints change, the surviving exact route identities should remain perceptible before navigation; one survivor may read LOCK, zero reads DEAD.
EVIDENCE MAY ACCUMULATE PASSIVELY / LOCALLY. Comparative interface evidence may be recorded in browser-local receipts without network telemetry or dedicated QA ritual.

LOCAL ACKNOWLEDGEMENT IS REWINDABLE. Browser-local orientation marks such as held-object SEEN retain enough local history to restore the prior boundary when available. The latest held-route SEEN exposes its inverse at the same point of action until another local orientation mutation becomes newer; older inverses remain in bounded ORIENTATION history. A legacy mark with no retained predecessor may reopen the unmarked/all-changes view. This never creates canonical read state.
TRACE ≠ AUTHORITY. A policy trace records selector/policy/operation evidence; it never creates permission, identity, priority or next-move authority.
VERIFY STATES ARE THREE-VALUED. FAIL proves violation; INDETERMINATE means required evidence/capability is unavailable; PASS requires every check for the requested profile to execute and pass.
FOCUS MAY BECOME RESOURCE ADDRESS. TRACE / VERIFY may bind the current FIELD focus as an opaque resource reference, but focus itself grants no READ/REMEMBER/ANSWER/DRAFT/ACT/ESCALATE permission.

RAW INPUT DOES NOT ENTER THE TRACE BY DEFAULT. Local reference tracing may derive an event digest/ref from typed text, but committed/exported traces remain content-free unless a future private policy explicitly governs retention.
TRACE IS AN OPERATION, NOT ANOTHER SOVEREIGN ROUTE. Root TRACE, Aperture TRACE and the TRACE / VERIFY fold are entrances to one focus-bound instrument.
STALE TRACE ≠ CURRENT PROOF. Changing FIELD focus invalidates the current trace binding until the trace is rerun against the new addressed resource.
WAITING != QUEUE. Human/world dependencies are visible without acquiring machine execution priority or authority.
TELEMETRY ≠ MATERIAL MUTATION. Generated heartbeat/status refresh commits may remain in exact Git chronology but must not drive material freshness, catch-up, priority or work selection.
AUTONOMY ≠ BUSYNESS. When the highest-value frontier is human/world-gated, one bounded directly-related fallback may prepare it; then STOP rather than forage unrelated archive work.

SIGNALS CONVERGE AT FOCUS, NOT AUTHORITY. Changed-route witnesses, CURRENT human/world gates and GitHub issues may feed one held-object action aperture, but each source retains its own lifecycle and mutation authority.

CI GREEN ≠ WORLD PROVED. Automated, browser, synthetic or repository verification may close implementation risk while leaving a real-device, physical, lived-use, human/social, private-input or world-event evidence gap. Such gaps remain explicit until an observed RETURN changes the claim.

SIGNAL PATTERN MUST PAY SEMANTIC RENT. Interference, cadence, pulse or motion on FIELD root may encode a real source-class state or overlap, but cannot decorate, rank, alarm, or manufacture urgency by itself; reduced-motion keeps the same state legible without animation.

DEPTH FOLDS; ACTION STAYS SURFACED. Root may hide recoverable navigation/instrument depth behind one semantic re-entry fold, but the current held action and one immediate deliberate entry remain visible. Folding may reduce chrome only when every displaced destination remains exactly reachable.

HANDOFF ≠ MUTATION. FIELD may serialize an explicitly addressed held object into an already-defined source-preserving handoff carrier, but the receiving host owns acceptance, mutation, undo and RETURN; creating the carrier alone never changes source or destination canonical state.

EXPLICIT WORLD-GAP TOKEN → RECOVERABLE PROOF RECORD. If a CURRENT head state explicitly declares WAITING_REAL_DEVICE, WAITING_PHYSICAL/PHYSICAL_PROOF_REQUIRED, or WAITING_PRIVATE_INPUT, a matching non-removed WAITING dependency must exist under that head route. This is coverage, not activation or priority.

GAME DONOR ≠ GAME SKIN. External games may donate mechanisms only through an abstract invariant + explicit non-transfer residue + current-host proof; fiction, branded visuals, economy and content do not transfer authority.

DONOR DIAGRAM ≠ NEW SYSTEM. Convergence/persona/communication/symbolic/transduction/governance/deployment donor frames may contribute only explicit invariants mapped onto existing FIELD carriers and native owners. They cannot mint route, lifecycle state, persona identity, schedule, authority, ontology, queue or dashboard. Every admitted transfer names the native owner, preserved channels, non-transfer residue and RETURN; unsupported narrative or aesthetic residue stays donor-only.

PATTERN ≠ TRUTH. Shared semantic signal patterns are perceptual projections over already-owned state. They may compress recognition across surfaces but may not infer domain state, create priority, or substitute for labels/accessible text.

ONE GESTURE → ONE INTERPRETATION. When projection layers overlap, the layer that claims an addressed activation must consume that activation or explicitly pass it through; one physical tap/click may not silently become both selection and navigation.

COMPRESSION MUST NAME ITS RESIDUE. Any root contraction may hide representation, chronology, constraints, evidence or witness detail only when the discarded layer remains exactly recoverable under a named owner/fold; hidden detail does not transfer authority upward.

SIGNAL LOCALITY. A pattern on an addressed glyph may encode only source classes explicitly bound to that same route. Global/unaddressed change, reality or external signals remain global summaries; they may not stain the currently held object.

ONBOARDING ≠ SECOND SURFACE. Guidance must arise from the canonical held object/carrier and recoverable residue; it may not create a parallel picker, object store, planner, effect authority, seen-state or dashboard.

COAXIALITY ≠ CONCENTRICITY. Related dimensions may share one held manipulation space only when each axis owns named state, relative transforms have host-defined semantics, one gesture has one primary interpretation, STATE ≠ VIEW, FOLD/BLOOM preserve recoverable residue, LIVE provenance remains distinguishable, and RETURN can reconstruct the causal path. Geometry alone may not manufacture domain meaning.

PACKET PRESENCE ≠ CONTINUATION. Transient packets reduce to exactly one egress class — NOW / DELTA / RESIDUE / GATE / NEXT / ARCHIVE — without becoming a queue or authority source. Canonical precedence is GATE → NOW → RESIDUE → NEXT → DELTA → ARCHIVE. A conditional STOP is GATE. Only explicit external/world/human WAITING is GATE; generic unresolved/internal WAITING or unresolved fact is RESIDUE. This semantic boundary is invariant across string/object/array/waiting_on/blocked_by shapes; key names or container presence alone cannot manufacture externality. Historical/superseded packets collapse to ARCHIVE unless current authority explicitly reactivates them. Precomputed egress labels are advisory only; only caller-supplied CURRENT/explicit selection context may create NOW. DELTA requires a material change claim plus host-attested sufficient EVIDENCE; an unwitnessed change is RESIDUE. Canonical uppercase packet fields remain compatibility aliases, and RETURN-to-CURRENT/replan-only prose is not a NEXT continuation.

PROJECTION EVIDENCE ≠ CANONICAL STATE. FIELD / PLAIN and future lawful lens comparisons may record which representation helped re-entry, clarity or reuse, but changing representation may not mutate held identity, address, source, authority, operation or next-move law; subjective preference is evidence about the view, not correctness proof.

SUBTRACTION REQUIRES SALVAGE PROOF. An addressed surface may be retired only after current/head authority, children, compatibility aliases and live runtime/tooling references are surveyed; preserve transferable mechanism, provenance and RETURN; FROZEN_DONOR and compatibility aliases are not debt; RETIRE_CANDIDATE never grants delete authority.

SHARED ACTION GRAMMAR HAS ONE SOURCE. FIELD teaching surfaces may project HOLD / TURN / RELEASE / TRACE / RETURN only from interphase-action-surface/v0.1 over the current carrier; duplicated UI verb tables are residue to remove, never parallel authority.

HOST OWNER + ACTION HINTS DERIVE FROM HOST-OWNED MANIFEST CONTRACTS. FIELD may project explicit field.owner, route.operation and AVAILABLE field.exit_paths, including exact targets, but must not maintain a parallel per-host capability table or infer authority from title/parent/current-head proximity. Missing field.owner remains neutral FIELD ROUTE; projection never transfers native state/effect authority.

GUIDANCE FOLDS INTO THE OBJECT. If OBJECT / FOCUS / NEXT≤3 / WITNESS / RETURN already derive from the held carrier, onboarding may not duplicate them in a second panel or browser-local seen state; teaching residue stays in the carrier grammar, contract and lineage evidence.

ATTENTION AGGREGATES DISSOLVE INTO OWNERS. If a root aggregate repeats NOW, route change, reality gates, external issues or actions already addressable at their canonical owners, retain only any unique reversible orientation state under STATUS and remove the aggregate surface.
FRAME FOLDS INTO OBJECT. HELD, NEXT, WITNESS and RETURN are properties of the one addressed object; FIELD may not render them as a second sibling dashboard beneath that object.

FORECAST ≠ EFFECT. A pre-commit forecast may expose only declared action authority, effect class, commit boundary, target and reversibility status. It cannot predict undeclared domain outcomes, execute the move, mint permission, or substitute for post-action WITNESS/RETURN.

root_order.meaning: Git master commits are the literal mutation chronology. AXIAL + manifest route dates are unequal addressed projections for focus/re-entry; neither may rewrite Git history or CURRENT attention.

activity_modes.RECOVER: Retrieve exact prior artifacts/lineage before synthesis.
activity_modes.INVESTIGATE: Resolve a bounded uncertainty, identity, mechanism or failure through targeted evidence.
activity_modes.RESEARCH: Gather/synthesize external or corpus evidence; output may be a research note/paper without implementation.
activity_modes.SPECULATE: Generate explicitly hypothetical/theoretical possibilities; no implementation/evidence claim.
activity_modes.SPECIFY: Turn an idea/finding into a bounded model, contract, schema or testable design.
activity_modes.IMPLEMENT: Create or materially change executable/physical artifact state.
activity_modes.VERIFY: Test, measure, audit or compare a claimed behavior/state.
activity_modes.OPERATE: Run, coordinate or maintain a live/current system without necessarily changing its design.
activity_modes.RELEASE: Surface/publish/promote a verified artifact or stable public projection.
activity_modes.UNKNOWN: Legacy/unclassified activity; valid only during migration.

required_same_change: set route.index.work_modes to the modes actually exercised by the delta
update receipt/RETURN only when the claimed artifact/test/release state changed
do_not_touch_when: recovering context but not yet committing recovered state

ui_contract.root_now: CURRENT.active_fronts are encoded as NOW attention marks on the shared route glyph/focus rather than a persistent dashboard block.
ui_contract.root_heads: CURRENT.current_heads remains a collapsed lineage reading; selecting a head updates the shared focus and does not navigate until OPEN.
ui_contract.root_map: MAP is collapsed by default. VISUAL/STRUCTURE/EVOLVE/VERSIONS/RECENT share the same manifest-route focus used by AXIAL / ROUTES; the runtime projection id AXIAL_LATEST is retained only for compatibility.
ui_contract.root_recent: Expose route.index.updated_at only as a manifest-route RECENT lens. Exact repository history is Git commits; route recency never implies priority.
ui_contract.root_frontier: Derive OPEN PORTS live from route.field.exit_paths; never maintain a duplicate hand-written backlog of the same exits.
ui_contract.corner_nav: Shared showcase route adapter remains the canonical BACK/PARENT/SHOWCASE control on tracked non-root routes.
ui_contract.style: Presentation/theme controls are a separate cross-site concern and must not alter semantic ordering/state.
ui_contract.root_visual: VISUAL is the default human sitemap projection: navigable parent/child field graph over manifest identity. STRUCTURE remains the exhaustive textual reading.
ui_contract.root_move_gate: Render CURRENT.execution_contract as a compact MOVE GATE adjacent to NOW: one bounded move → evidence-bearing RETURN → explicit replan. It is a control law, not another project/front.
ui_contract.root_scale: Presentation density is automatic and internal. FIELD does not expose FIELD/ROUTE/OBJECT as root modes; ROUTE remains an address/projection term, not a user control. MAP depth remains an optional topology instrument under STATUS. Focus identity and native authority are invariant across presentation changes.
ui_contract.root_scale_lens_handoff: Selected MAP route may be copied locally into SCALE LENS via scale.lens.handoff.v01. This is a projection handoff; Lens cannot mutate canonical FIELD manifest state. FIELD reuses the Lens law 'stable focus across zoom' but does not duplicate the deep-lab domain/scope machinery.
ui_contract.root_fovea_scale: FOVEA is optional local detail over the same FIELD focus, not a global scale control or second store. Its readout exposes object identity/state rather than presentation-scale vocabulary. Pointer/radial gestures may HOLD or OPEN native addresses but do not change CURRENT attention, priority or authority.
ui_contract.root_play: /field-play.html derives public-safe missions from manifest gaps plus FIELD_ISSUES entries with play_safe=true. Returns remain report-only and require review.
ui_contract.root_evolve: EVOLVE is a named projection over canonical manifest routes carrying route.evolution. It shows host, generation, stage, mutation and evidence gate; it is not a new backlog or authority source.
ui_contract.root_identity_fold: Identity folding is permitted only inside secondary projections where repetition harms legibility. ROUTES / LIVE SURFACE keeps one visible chip per addressed surface; exact Git mutations remain separately recoverable under collapsed CHANGE / GIT.
ui_contract.root_latest: The compact glyph field is the primary addressed-surface projection. Each mark may carry its own route-local semantic signal. Activating a mark once changes shared focus; activating the held mark again opens its native address. Locally unseen change is acknowledged from the held object, not a duplicate change-card feed. Literal repository chronology stays under STATUS → CHANGE / GIT; glyph-field signal/order never becomes Git history or priority.
ui_contract.root_issues: Render open GitHub issues as a separate newest-activity-first repo-truth list. Live GitHub API may refresh a checked-in /control/FIELD_ISSUES.json fallback. Issue presence is not priority.
ui_contract.root_density: /field-presentation.js adapts MARK / COMPACT / FULL to viewport width as a presentation-only projection. Legacy explicit density locks are cleared on boot. Compression may reduce repeated tokens toward glyph marks only when the hidden detail remains recoverable through the held object, REFINE / PROVE, STATUS, or native owner.
ui_contract.root_glyph: /field-glyph.js remains the compact identity/state mark. Exact CURRENT heads may compose the same mark inside the existing VIEW-only project-head/interphase glyph witness. Semantic signal is orthogonal: the surrounding FIELD mark/header pattern derives from route-owned change/reality/external witnesses and cannot alter glyph identity, project state or native authority.
ui_contract.root_axial_latest: AXIAL remains a lawful-support/refinement instrument over the same shared focus but is collapsed under REFINE / PROVE by default. Its strips, survivor set and support collapse may refine or falsify the held object without competing with the primary glyph field.
ui_contract.root_axial_survivors: Render the current exact-match set between the strips and focus aperture. One survivor = LOCK 1; zero = DEAD; many = LIVE n. A short survivor-count trail may expose how the possibility space collapsed during the current interaction.
ui_contract.root_axial_trial: Store only local browser interaction counts under field-axial-trial/v0.1: AXIAL focus selections, route-pulse focus selections (legacy field name latest_focus retained for compatibility), dead intersections, OPEN counts and rough focus→OPEN elapsed time. No automatic network transmission and no claim that elapsed time alone proves usability.
ui_contract.root_axial_deeplink: Embedded focus may serialize ax_state / ax_op / ax_mode / focus into the root URL. Reload/share must reconstruct the same bounded focus state when values still exist.
ui_contract.root_trace_verify: /field-policy-trace.mjs binds the current shared FIELD focus to a local reference policy trace; shows seven gates plus causal events; runs /policy-trace-verifier.mjs for STRUCTURAL/REPLAY/SEALED status; local commit/export excludes raw input.
ui_contract.root_trace_status: STRUCTURAL/REPLAY/SEALED are evidence levels, not quality scores. Explicitly unsealed trace fails SEALED; unavailable replay/schema evidence returns INDETERMINATE.
ui_contract.root_trace_placement: TRACE / VERIFY is a collapsed secondary instrument inside STATUS. Top navigation and the focused-object TRACE action open that same nested instrument by first opening STATUS; TRACE no longer occupies the primary re-entry stack.
ui_contract.root_trace_binding: A rendered trace is bound to the route focus present when RUN TRACE executes. If shared FIELD focus changes, the trace becomes visibly STALE and COMMIT is disabled until rerun. Old trace export remains possible as historical evidence.
ui_contract.root_waiting: REALITY GAP / YOU is detailed human/world evidence depth under collapsed STATUS. ACTIVE gates derive only from explicit CURRENT.current_heads[].next_executable human/world states. /control/WAITING.json preserves durable dependency memory as PARKED or REMOVED history and may enrich a matching CURRENT gate by id. Parked, conditional, ambient-use and removed dependencies never become obligations merely because they exist. SEEN / REWIND / MARK ALL do not resolve a CURRENT gate.
ui_contract.root_reentry: NOW / RECOVER / CONVERGE is a collapsed one-line semantic router. NOW opens CURRENT/QUEUE attention; RECOVER opens the generic Recovery vault for exact source + lineage and must not privilege a current project head; CONVERGE opens NEXUS for coordination + RETURN.
ui_contract.root_convergence: Generated convergence data/plain readings remain available to NEXUS/READFIELD with generation timestamps, but the generated KPI strip is retired from FIELD root. Root live frame derives CURRENT + master HEAD rather than caching a second status dashboard.
ui_contract.root_truth_grammar: Use Φ for host/authority frame and φ for the current addressed focus/projection. The root reads CURRENT → φ FOCUS → ROUTES; Git/TRACE/STATUS are subordinate evidence or instruments opened on demand.
ui_contract.root_status: STATUS is the single secondary residue owner. Its rail summarizes LOCAL unseen orientation, REALITY gates, ISSUES, HEADS, MAP and PORTS. Detailed CHANGE / GIT, KEY, TRACE, ISSUES, REALITY GAP / YOU, ORIENTATION / LOCAL, HEADS, MAP and PORTS stay collapsed beneath it. STATUS does not own NOW, next-move authority or canonical state.
ui_contract.root_tzimtzum: Primary root hierarchy: title + one immediate PLAY action → folded re-entry → CURRENT/φ truth line → one held object + compact glyph field → collapsed STATUS. Teaching, project depth, local orientation, reality proof, issues, refinement, chronology and maps fold into their owners rather than prepend another attention/dashboard surface.
ui_contract.root_ports: PORTS / EXIT STATE projects manifest field.exit_paths without treating every non-AVAILABLE status as unresolved work. Exact exit statuses remain canonical and are grouped for presentation into AVAILABLE, BUILD / PROVE, HUMAN / EXPORT BOUNDARY, VERIFY and PARKED / OPTIONAL. Candidate, reference, donor and deferred exits are not counted as live debt; unknown statuses render OTHER / UNCLASSIFIED.
ui_contract.root_route_freshness: FIELD exposes the newest manifest route-index clock against MATERIAL Git HEAD. Pure generated NEXUS board-refresh heartbeat commits remain exact Git history but do not manufacture route freshness debt.

glyph_block_rule.law: Compress repeated addressed projections, never semantic content or authority.
hybrid: WAITING: route/state may compress to a glyph, but the human move remains visible text
preserve_text: ISSUES until an issue has a lawful addressed route/object mapping
glyph_block_rule.admission: An entry needs stable address/route identity plus state before glyph-only compression is lawful.
glyph_block_rule.return: Activating a glyph must resolve to the same addressed object; the glyph never becomes a second taxonomy or store.

ui_contract.root_action_aperture: One held manifest route remains the object. Its own aperture contains state/operation/native owner, one primary native action edge, at most two additional host-derived lawful moves, contextual browser-local SEEN ⇄ UNDO SEEN, a declared pre-commit FORECAST, visible WITNESS and exact RETURN. Host owner/action hints derive only from explicit manifest field.owner + operation + AVAILABLE field.exit_paths; when host actions exist the first exact action becomes the primary edge and the next two remain inline. Generic routes retain OPEN/DO plus at most one explicit INTERPHASE → DAYLINE or COPY ACTION handoff. Each exposed move may project only its declared effect class, authority/commit boundary, target and reversibility; forecast is VIEW evidence, never execution or outcome prediction. DAYLINE handoff remains source-preserving and receiver-owned. TRACE / COMPARE / action-copy / AXIAL proof remain recoverable under REFINE / PROVE. No sibling HELD/NEXT/WITNESS panel, capability table, second store, priority or effect authority.
ui_contract.root_reality_gap: REALITY GAP / YOU is not a new registry. It is the active human/world proof reading derived from CURRENT.current_heads[].next_executable; WAITING remains parked/removed dependency memory only. COPY TEST serializes the bounded world test locally with exact route plus a stable same-site OPEN URL, but cannot resolve it. Parked physical tests remain recoverable without becoming NOW.
ui_contract.root_attention_signal: Semantic signal is route-local on FIELD marks and the held-object header: CHANGED only from that route's unresolved local index-change witness; REALITY only from an explicit CURRENT human/world gate whose route exactly matches; EXTERNAL only from an external record that explicitly names that route; MIXED only when two or more route-owned classes coexist. There is no global CATCH moire strip. Unaddressed/global counts remain textual owner summaries under STATUS. Pattern never changes authority or priority.
ui_contract.root_depth_contraction: FIELD root exposes one immediate PLAY action and one held-object field. The held object itself owns owner/address, primary action, ≤2 secondary lawful moves, pre-commit forecast, witness, exact RETURN and the immediate SEEN ⇄ UNDO SEEN inverse. CURRENT / RECOVER / CONVERGE plus utility navigation remain in the collapsed re-entry fold. AXIAL constraints, survivor set, egress/MORE HERE residue and proof tools live under REFINE / PROVE. Older REWIND / MARK ALL orientation history, REALITY, Git chronology and secondary evidence live under STATUS.
ui_contract.semantic_signal_skin: Shared /lib/field-signal.css + /lib/field-signal.js remain projection-only. CLEAR/CHANGED/REALITY/EXTERNAL/MIXED encode already-owned source-class state. Scope is part of meaning: a global summary and an addressed glyph may lawfully display different tokens at the same moment. Recipients must not infer a route association that the source did not provide.
ui_contract.root_packet_egress_projection: FIELD root is a direct consumer of /lib/field-egress-reducer.mjs, not a second reducer. Held-object route adapters supply only already-owned CURRENT attention, explicit CURRENT human/world gates, explicit unresolved/open-gap material, existing next_executable, and unresolved local route delta. Ordinary FIELD focus is never passed as reducer selected/NOW authority. The canonical GATE → NOW → RESIDUE → NEXT → DELTA → ARCHIVE result is projection-only; receipts/evidence do not become RESIDUE merely by existing.
ui_contract.root_projection_ablation: /field-play.html hosts the first bounded FIELD ↔ PLAIN representation ablation over one public-safe mission identity. Projection selection is VIEW-only; the canonical mission packet remains unchanged; only copied RETURN evidence records projection and subjective clarity / re-entry / use-again.
ui_contract.root_salvage: No persistent root panel. /control/FIELD_SALVAGE_POLICY.json + the read-only salvage audit are proof/control depth only. FIELD may use their classification as evidence for convergence, never as deletion authority.
ui_contract.root_onboarding_contraction: FIELD has no separate onboarding visor. The held object is the guide: fieldCarrierForFocus() + InterphaseCarrier.actionSurface() retain the canonical WAKE→SOURCE / CUT→FRAME / HOLD→FOCUS / TURN→OPERATE / TRACE→WITNESS / AGAIN→RETURN grammar, while the existing held-object aperture and collapsed REFINE / PROVE depth expose object, lawful moves, witness and exact RETURN. No onboarding-localStorage bit, ?visor mode, duplicate guide DOM, route picker, store, planner or effect authority.
ui_contract.root_orientation: Browser-local route acknowledgement is residue, not a root attention surface. An exact held route exposes SEEN only while its manifest index touch is locally unseen. SEEN changes only field.catchup.items.v02 plus bounded field.catchup.history.v01; each new route-SEEN stores {route, previous boundary, applied boundary, local action time}. Immediately after SEEN, the same held control becomes UNDO SEEN and remains the immediate inverse across reloads until a newer local SEEN or MARK ALL action supersedes it. A newer local action becomes the immediate undo target; the older action remains reachable through the bounded 40-entry STATUS → ORIENTATION / LOCAL REWIND history. If the route receives a newer manifest touch, SEEN represents that new unresolved change rather than the older inverse. None of this changes CURRENT, manifest, Git, WAITING, issues, priority or native state. Legacy field.catchup.* names remain compatibility state, not a product concept.

BOTTLENECK.rule: Return every declared exit whose status is not AVAILABLE. Filtering never changes route or evidence state.
BOTTLENECK.non_claim: Unresolved exit status exposes interface/proof debt; it is not an automatic priority ranking or evidence that an adapter works.

RETURN.rule: RETURN closes the authority of the just-executed move. Any subsequent move is selected again from returned state.
RETURN.non_claim: A RETURN may suggest next routes but does not authorize or autoplay them.

route_state_contract.law: route.kind answers what a surface is; route.state answers its current lifecycle/evidence posture. EXPERIMENT remains a valid kind but is deprecated as a route.state.

states.STABLE: Verified or settled public surface; ordinary use does not require an outstanding named proof gate.
states.ACTIVE: Current runnable/operational head. May still have bounded limitations or unresolved exits.
states.PROOF_REQUIRED: Runnable/specifiable surface whose own named promotion or consequence claim is blocked on explicit evidence.
states.CANDIDATE: Bounded candidate model/orientation that is intentionally revisable and not canonical.
states.REFERENCE: Runnable/reference fixture used to inspect or compare a mechanism; not itself proof of a live adapter or deployment.
states.PARKED: Preserved runnable/comparison surface with no current execution obligation; resume only on a named dependency.
states.DONOR: Useful surviving mechanism/source whose current role is transfer into another head rather than independent advancement.
states.FROZEN_DONOR: Exact recovered donor preserved against in-place modernization; transfer only named mechanisms while keeping source bytes/identity intact.
states.RECOVER: Known gap or partial recovery where exact source/evidence is still required.
states.UTILITY: Validator/docs/support surface rather than a product/head lifecycle.

rules: Do not use EXPERIMENT as a substitute for uncertainty, lack of proof, parking, donor status or active use.
Put experimental form in route.kind or the release hypothesis/known_limits.
Put unresolved consequence/proof requirements in route.field.exit_paths and PROOF_REQUIRED when they block the artifact's own promotion claim.
Historical release receipts may retain their contemporaneous state; append current classification rather than rewriting provenance.

NOW.meaning: At most three attention/execution fronts. This is the only root reading that implies current focus.

HEADS.meaning: Collapsed advanced lineage reading. Retained heads remain recoverable without occupying primary navigation.

MAP.meaning: Durable public address graph using parent relations and lifecycle state. Existence is not priority.

OPEN_PORTS.meaning: Compatibility reading for PORTS / EXIT STATE. Exact exit statuses remain canonical; AVAILABLE and PARKED/OPTIONAL are not live debt. BUILD / PROVE, HUMAN / EXPORT BOUNDARY, VERIFY and OTHER / UNCLASSIFIED remain separately visible.

RECENT.meaning: Secondary addressed-route touch projection. It compresses surface metadata and is not a complete repository changelog.

EVOLVE.meaning: Bounded evolutionary work: host → question → one mutation → evidence gate → transfer/park/compost. It is a projection over canonical routes, not a separate queue.

LATEST.source: GitHub master commits + showcase-manifest route projection
LATEST.meaning: Two unequal readings: exact commits provide literal repository chronology; manifest glyphs provide current addressed route re-entry. Never collapse one into the other.

ISSUES.meaning: Declared repo open loops. Visibility is not priority or authority.

AXIAL_LATEST.source: showcase-manifest routes + route.index.updated_at + AXIAL 0.7 support law
AXIAL_LATEST.meaning: Primary focus compositor. Unequal route/state/operation/work-mode vocabularies expose exact support and survivor-set collapse while preserving ordinary chronological control below.

TRACE_VERIFY.meaning: Collapsed-by-default proof lens over the currently focused route. It demonstrates policy trace mechanics with a local reference policy and cannot stand in for real private person/resource policy resolution.

VERSIONS.meaning: Release lineage reading: shipped semantic versions with exact commit/receipt provenance. Distinct from RECENT mutation chronology and EVOLVE bounded experiments.

WAITING.meaning: ACTIVE human/world gates come only from CURRENT. WAITING.json preserves PARKED dependencies and REMOVED history; neither class implies present user obligation.

evolution_contract.purpose: Turn experimental work into bounded variation → evidence → selection → transfer rather than a permanent bucket of prototypes.
evolution_contract.carrier: showcase-manifest route.evolution; do not maintain a separate experiment registry.
evolution_contract.applies_to: Any live route whose kind=experiment and state is not DONOR/FROZEN_DONOR, plus candidate workbenches intentionally enrolled in evolution.

stages.FRAME: Name host, question, baseline, one mutation and evidence gate before expanding implementation.
stages.TEST: Run the smallest comparator that can change the experiment's disposition.
stages.SELECT: Evidence exists; choose pass/fail/ambiguous explicitly before more mutation.
stages.TRANSFER: Move only the surviving mechanism into the named host; the experiment itself does not automatically become a new sovereign product.
stages.HOLD: No present work. Resume only on a named dependency or explicit selection.
stages.COMPOST: Failed/superseded branch is retained as negative knowledge or donor residue; no beautification debt.

laws: ONE MUTATION PER GENERATION. If multiple mechanisms change, split or reset the generation.
BASELINE BEFORE NOVELTY. Every test names the plain/current comparator it must beat or materially differ from.
PASS MEANS TRANSFER, NOT EMPIRE. A successful experiment normally donates a mechanism to its host; it does not earn an independent roadmap by default.
FAILURE RETURNS VALUE. A failed branch becomes PARKED/DONOR/COMPOST with its evidence retained so the same idea is not rediscovered from zero.
NO SECOND GENERATION WITHOUT RETURN. Evidence closes the current generation; a new mutation requires explicit replan.
PHYSICAL CLAIMS REQUIRE PHYSICAL RECEIPTS. Digital proxies can prepare but never satisfy a physical correspondence claim.
evolution_contract.host_rule: host must resolve to an existing manifest route and names the recipient/authority that would change if the experiment succeeds.

truth_grammar.Φ: Host / authoritative frame. On FIELD root this points toward CURRENT/domain authority; Φ never means that every visible datum is canonical.
truth_grammar.φ: Current addressed focus / projection inside a Φ host. φ may move freely without creating identity, priority or mutation authority.
truth_grammar.git: Exact repository mutation chronology: commit SHA, offset-aware timestamp, subject and complete history.
truth_grammar.current: Attention authority: active fronts, retained heads and current execution frame.
truth_grammar.manifest: Addressed route/state projection. index.updated_at is curated surface-touch metadata, offset-normalized for display; INDEX↔GIT drift remains visible when exact Git HEAD is newer.
truth_grammar.interphase: Shared select/focus/project/RETURN mechanics; domain host remains authoritative.

OTHER.label: OTHER / UNCLASSIFIED
OTHER.law: Unknown future statuses never silently become BUILD / PROVE.
